# Version 4.157.0
> **Skia m157 rendering corrections** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.157.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.4.0.200/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.157 updates to Skia m157 and makes LibraryImport calling conventions explicit. The collected engine updates correct clipped paths, glyph replay and Graphite readback. Changes after Preview 1 additionally address reflected hairline caps, text-atlas selection and affected Mali Vulkan device-loss cleanup.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia m157 with raster and GPU fixes** — Updates to m157 with corrections for convex-path rasterization, coverage-mask clamping, glyph replay validation, Graphite clipping and alpha-to-RGBx readback. The engine update preserves the existing managed binding surface. ([#5542](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5542), [#5612](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5612), [#5630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5630))
- **GPU corrections collected after Preview 1** — Reflected transforms no longer enlarge zero-length square-capped hairlines, and rounded text-atlas indices avoid selecting the wrong sampler. Ganesh and Graphite defer affected device-loss cleanup for ARM proprietary Vulkan driver versions 42 through below 56. ([#5670](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5670))

## Bug Fixes

- **Explicit cdecl for LibraryImport** — Generated LibraryImport declarations now specify the same cdecl convention as DllImport and callback paths, correcting an ABI mismatch on Windows x86 without changing public APIs or native exports. ([#5565](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5565))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.200

HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.200 retains native HarfBuzz 14.4.0 and an unchanged public API surface. Its generated LibraryImport declarations now explicitly select cdecl, matching the existing DllImport convention.

## Preview 1 (November 6, 2026)

Introduced Skia m157 with clipped-path, glyph-replay and Graphite readback fixes. Generated LibraryImport declarations explicitly select cdecl; HarfBuzzSharp moves to package revision 14.4.0.200 without a native engine upgrade.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.156.0-rc.1.26553.11...v4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1)
